items.summary: CTO disposition: complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z. Record root cause or justified closure, deterministic tests, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback point, release and security boundaries, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Do not create duplicate work or admit new implementation while delivery remains saturated.

CTO approves containment. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 active slots, with 57 improvements measuring and 21 failed requests. Preserve launch and security gates; do not admit new production, site-factory, prototype, telemetry, spend, or duplicate queue work this cycle. Existing read-only snapshot evidence is sufficient for current decisions.

After one delivery slot is released, execute only the existing canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Do not create another request. Preserve destinations and imagery; clarify the existing affiliate action and adjacent disclosure; retain responsive, keyboard, contrast, semantic-link, and 44px touch-target requirements. Validate tests, build, links, disclosure, accessibility, and functional behavior. Measure only existing outbound affiliate clicks and eligible sessions for 14 days; do not claim revenue or causal lift.

Defer the reusable control-plane integrity layer as a backlog specification, not an active implementation. Its scope may cover canonical deduplication, slot ownership, failure-to-repair linkage, approval-to-request traceability, and blocker aging using existing snapshot fields only. No new telemetry, production mutation, dependency, or queue admission is authorized until capacity is released and a bounded implementation contract exists.

Retain the site-factory pipeline as preview-only and capacity-gated. Do not publish, deploy, add domains, enable analytics or affiliate collection, or spend money. No site-factory work enters the queue until the existing repair-or-close case releases a slot and launch, security, compliance, measurement, ownership, and rollback gates are evidenced.
